title: WPMS/67/2009 of DALID HASAN Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND and ORS

paras.text:
WPMS No.67 of 2009
Hon'ble Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.
Heard Mr. Ramji Srivastava, Advocate for the petitioner, Mr. R.
C. Arya, Standing Counsel for the State of Uttarakhand and Mr. Deepak
Sharma, Advocate for the respondent no.4.
The petitioner runs a fair price shop in village Khushaalpur,
Dehradun. The District Supply Officer, Dehradun vide impugned
order dated 31.12.2008 suspended the licence of the petitioner's fair
price shop. The impugned order merely states that the shop was
inspected and it was found that there were certain anomalies. The
impugned order further states that the Gram Pradhan had received
several complaints against the petitioner.
This Court has perused the impugned order and finds that it does
not give details as to how much quantity of foodgrains was missing
from the shop and on which date and time the shop was inspected.
Moreover, the petitioner alleged mala-fide in the matter stating that the
licence of the petitioner was cancelled at the instance of the Gram
Pradhan since petitioner's wife too contested the election of Gram
Pradhan in the year 2008 and lost. In other words, a political rivalry is
being alleged.
Be that as it may, the impugned order does not give the basic
details for cancelling the licence of the petitioner, namely, as to how
much quantity of foodgrains was missing and the date and time of
inspection was not mentioned.
In light of aforesaid, the impugned order is liable to be quashed
and is hereby quashed. The writ petition is allowed.
No order as to costs.
